caption: A saucepan of milk on a stove begins to boil, and the milk foams up rapidly toward the rim.

sa.check: A saucepan of milk sits on a hob.
The foam climbs toward the rim.
The foam rises fast enough to threaten a spill.
The milk lies flat before the foam rises.

pc.expect: The foam only rises while the pan stays on the heat; it falls back only if the pan is lifted off.
pc.fail: The foam sinks back while the pan sits on the burner with nothing changed; or the foam rises and falls in turn on the heat; or the foam rises before the milk has begun to bubble; or the foam collapses and swells again with nothing touched.

pc.expect: The milk is a liquid that throws up a thick bubbly foam which climbs the pan's wall and collapses when it spills or cools.
pc.fail: The milk stays a flat mirror while foam stands above it; or the foam stands as rigid spikes that keep their shape when the pan is moved; or the milk sets solid; or the foam pours off as a thin clear liquid.

pc.expect: The foam climbs the inside of the pan and, if it goes over, runs down the outside, while the milk otherwise stays in the pan.
pc.fail: The foam climbs the outside of the pan and goes in over the rim; or foam lifts off the pan and hangs above it; or foam runs upward on the pan's outside; or the milk runs up the pan's wall and out with no foam at the rim.

pc.expect: Foam near the rim means the milk below has risen: the level and the foam go up together.
pc.fail: The foam reaches the rim while the visible milk below is calm and far from full; or the milk's level drops while the foam climbs; or the foam climbs while the surface below shows no bubbles.

pc.expect: One pan of milk; the milk stays in the pan except where it spills over the rim.
pc.fail: Milk passes through the pan's wall; or the level jumps up with nothing added; or a second pan appears; or the pan changes shape.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the milk's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or the milk changes colour; or the hob's knobs move by themselves.
